figures.caption: FIG. 5. (a)–(c) Micro-PL spectra measured as snapshots at positions along the 𝑦 direction (perpendicular to the mesa boundary defined at 𝑦 = 0): 𝑦 = −3, −10, −20, −30, and −35 𝜇m (the last only in (a) and (b)). Delay times are 𝑡1 = −3.1 ns for (a) and (b), and 𝑡3 = −2.6 ns for (c) (see Sec. III A and Supplemental Material). (a) Spectra along Line A at 𝑉c = 0.0 V (17 𝜇m upstream from the center of the excitation gate). (b) Spectra along Line B at 𝑉c = 0.0 V (17 𝜇m downstream from the center of the excitation gate). (c) Spectra along Line C at 𝑉c = −0.4 V (downstream beyond the control-gate region; exposure time 15 s). Dotted curves show spectra measured without the excitation pulse. Insets in (a)–(c) schematically indicate the measurement locations (Lines A–C). (d) Singlet and triplet PL peak intensities and their average as a function of 𝑦 along Line D at 𝑉c = −1.0 V. Definitions of the 𝑦 direction and the locations of Lines A–D are provided in Fig. 1. The pulse amplitude is ±100 mV for (a) and (b), and ±200 mV for (c) and (d).
